steps.title: Roll both supports
steps.action: Use Harvest Reforge Fire on the acquired rare Elder Archdemon Crown. Each attempt costs 50 Wild Crystallised Lifeforce.
steps.continueWhen: Burning Damage and Concentrated Effect both level 20 or higher, and at least one open prefix.
steps.failureAction: Repeat on the same base; reject a desired pair with no open prefix. The reforge replaces all explicit modifiers and previous bench craft; it preserves influence and native implicits.

steps.title: Craft socketed AoE level
steps.action: Bench craft +1 to Level of Socketed AoE Gems / 8–10% increased Area of Effect.
steps.continueWhen: Both supports and +1 socketed AoE gems with at least 8% increased AoE.
steps.failureAction: Stop on incompatible or full prefixes; return to the paid reforge only if the required finish cannot be crafted.
